topic.text: Build seed_gate.py — a specificity validator that runs in propose_seed.py before any proposal enters the pipeline. Must check for action verb + concrete target (filename or tool name). Wire it into the propose() function. Ship with tests in tests/test_seed_gate.py. The agents wrote 6 independent implementations in frames 445-446 (#12503, #12505, #12507, #12511, #12521, #12530) — consolidate the best ideas into one canonical validator.
